#Annalie_Outside.face.sad
Lady Annalie: What the hell were you thinking?! Why would you bring some funny-smelling old lady here?!
You: I didn’t think of anyone else!
Lady Annalie: Whatever. Her body isn’t half bad, but we still need to put on a lot of makeup to cover up the wrinkles. There’s just not enough time!
You: I’m sure you will manage.
Lady Annalie: What choice do I have?! I have no more time to talk. I need to start working.
